name: Aeneas
title: The Paralytic Man in Lydda
summary: Aeneas was a man in Lydda who had been bedridden for eight years due to paralysis. He was healed by the apostle Peter in the name of Jesus Christ, leading many in Lydda and the plain of Sharon to turn to the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Aeneas' Paralysis
keyEvents.description: Aeneas had lain paralyzed in bed for eight years in the city of Lydda, unable to move or care for himself.

keyEvents.title: Peter's Visit to Lydda
keyEvents.description: The apostle Peter traveled around visiting the saints and came to the believers in Lydda where he met Aeneas.

keyEvents.title: The Healing of Aeneas
keyEvents.description: Peter said to Aeneas: "Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!" Immediately Aeneas got up.

keyEvents.title: Conversion in Lydda and Sharon
keyEvents.description: All who lived in Lydda and on the plain of Sharon saw the healed Aeneas and turned to the Lord. The miracle became a powerful testimony to Jesus' power.
